description: Core admin panel UI: rebuild AdminPanelPage with 4-tab stack navigation, no BottomNav, AdminUserDetail inline component, admin redirect in RequireUsername
steps: 1. Rebuild AdminPanelPage with navigation state machine, sticky header, sign-out button, 4 tabs
2. Create AdminUserDetail.tsx with moderation actions and navigation
3. Refactor AdminUsersTab to call onOpenUser prop instead of modal
4. Update RequireUsername to redirect admins to /admin
acceptance_criteria: Sticky header shows Shield icon, title, admin name, Sign Out button
4 tab buttons visible when stack empty
User detail shows inline with actions
findings: All 5 steps completed. Build: clean (vite 11.34s). Tests: 158/158 passed across 32 files. Two test fixes needed during implementation: (1) DialogTitle text matched 'Grant Administrator Role?' (with ?) per original modal; (2) Audit Log tab test used unique paragraph text to avoid multi-match on 'Audit Log'. RequireUsername now reads role from profile fetch and redirects administrators to /admin for non-exempt paths.
